## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 411 captures during December 2023. This activity provides the basis for the review of image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The volume should be considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the results requiring referral.

## Image quality

There were 22 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 5.4. The clinic should continue to monitor image quality and identify any recurring problems during routine operations. The clinic lead has asked staff to log recurring camera issues with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

Grading identified 117 referable results. These cases should proceed through the applicable follow-up arrangements. The median lag between capture and grading was 3. This measure should continue to be monitored with the monthly activity and image quality results to support timely review and consistent service delivery.
